markets.early_close_condition: If an event described in the Payout Criterion occurs, expiration will be moved to an earlier date and time in accordance with Rule 7.2.
markets.rules_primary: If Birch and Swinnerton-Dyer Conjecture is the first Millennium Prize Problem solved after Issuance, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
A Millennium Prize Problem is considered Solved at the earliest time that any of the following occurs:

A complete proof, disproof, or counterexample addressing the problem as officially formulated is published in a peer-reviewed journal.
The Clay Mathematics Institute or another recognized authoritative academic body officially recognizes in writing that the problem has been resolved by reference to a specific written work.
At least two Source Agencies report that the problem has been proven, disproven, or otherwise resolved by reference to a specific publicly available written work.

If multiple problems have the same Solution Time, each is treated as the next problem Solved and the market resolves to 1/N, where N is the number of tied problems. A qualifying solution ceases to count if, before Expiration, it is formally retracted, withdrawn, repudiated, rescinded, or found to contain an identified and unaddressed error.

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the event occurs.
markets.rules_primary: If the FDA approves VERVE-102 for marketing before Jan 1, 2030, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
An approval is defined as:

For new drugs: FDA issuance of an approval letter for a New Drug Application (NDA) or Biologics License Application (BLA)
For already-marketed drugs seeking new indications: FDA approval of a supplemental NDA (sNDA) or supplemental BLA (sBLA) for the specific indication referenced
For generic drugs: FDA approval of an Abbreviated New Drug Application (ANDA)
For biosimilars: FDA approval of a 351(k) application

The following constitute approvals that trigger the Payout Criterion:

Standard approval (traditional approval based on clinical benefit)
Accelerated approval (based on surrogate endpoints)
Approval with Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy (REMS)
Approval with restricted distribution or indication limitations, except compassionate use/expanded access programs

The following do NOT constitute approvals:

Complete Response Letters (CRLs) indicating the application cannot be approved in its current form
Approvable letters that require additional actions before approval
Tentative approvals pending patent or exclusivity expiration
FDA requests for additional information or studies
Extension of Prescription Drug User Fee Amendments dates
Approval for compassionate use or expanded access programs only
Emergency Use Authorization (EUA) without full approval
Approval only for export or for use outside the United States

If the FDA issues a Complete Response Letter before Jan 1, 2030, the market will resolve to No unless the FDA subsequently approves VERVE-102 after addressing the CRL concerns and before Jan 1, 2030.

If the FDA convenes an Advisory Committee that votes against approval but the FDA approves VERVE-102 anyway before Jan 1, 2030, the market will resolve to Yes.

If VERVE-102 receives accelerated approval that is later withdrawn before Jan 1, 2030, the market will resolve based on whether the initial accelerated approval occurred after Issuance (Yes), regardless of the subsequent withdrawal.

If the drug sponsor withdraws the application before FDA action and before Jan 1, 2030, the market will resolve to No immediately.
markets.subtitle: Before 2030
markets.title: Will the FDA approve VERVE-102 before Jan 1, 2030?

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the MacAskill side is determined to have won.
markets.rules_primary:
If the highest percentage increase in U.S. real GDP per capita over its previous peak for Q3 2026 through Q4 2033 is at least 

15%, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
This market is based on the public challenge agreed upon in August 2026 between the following sides:

MacAskill side (fast growth): William MacAskill, Samuel Albanie and Tom Cohen
Moll side (no fast growth): Benjamin Moll and Andrew Ho

GROWTH CONDITION

The MacAskill side wins if, for any quarter from Q3 2026 through Q4 2033, U.S. real GDP per capita is at least 15% above the previous peak.

For each eligible quarter \(Q\):

The applicable quarterly value is U.S. real GDP per capita for \(Q\).
The previous peak is the highest quarterly U.S. real GDP per capita value reported for any quarter through and including \(Q-4\).
Peak-relative growth is calculated as:

(Quarterly value ÷ previous peak − 1) × 100

The condition is met when the resulting value is at least 15%. Equivalently, real GDP per capita for the applicable quarter must be at least 1.15 times the previous peak.

This peak-relative comparison prevents growth caused solely by a rebound from a recession from qualifying.

DATA SOURCE

Resolution will use the official U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis measure “Real gross domestic product per capita,” published in NIPA Table 7.1 as series A939RX. The series is quarterly, seasonally adjusted and expressed in inflation-adjusted chained dollars.

The series is also displayed by FRED.

The quarterly value and the values used to establish the previous peak will be taken from the same BEA publication or data vintage. Calculations will use the published levels without separately rounding the resulting percentage.

CLOSE CALLS

If a BEA release shows peak-relative growth from 14.5% through 15.5%, inclusive, that quarter will instead be evaluated using BEA’s third estimate for the quarter.

Using the third estimate:

A value of at least 15% satisfies the growth condition.
A value below 15% does not satisfy the growth condition.

Once a quarter is subject to this close-call procedure, its third estimate controls the determination for that quarter.

DETERMINATION

The market resolves to MacAskill side as soon as an eligible quarter satisfies the growth condition.

If no eligible quarter has satisfied the condition when BEA first publishes its estimate for Q4 2033:

The market resolves to MacAskill side if the Q4 2033 result is above 15.5%.
The market resolves to Moll side if the result is below 14.5%.
If the result is from 14.5% through 15.5%, determination will be deferred until BEA publishes its third estimate for Q4 2033.

Once the market has been determined, subsequent revisions will not change the result.

The calculation does not require determining whether AI caused the reported growth. “Per capita” refers only to the human population. Resolution is based on the criteria above and does not depend on whether the participants concede, make the agreed payments or subsequently amend their private arrangement.

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the economic data is released.
markets.rules_primary: If the U.S. goods and services deficit for calendar year 2032 is strictly above $500 billion dollars, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The Underlying is the nominal goods and services balance on a balance-of-payments basis. It will not use the goods-only deficit, the advance goods report, the December monthly deficit, or inflation-adjusted trade data.

Because the agencies generally report the balance as a negative number, the market will use the absolute size of the deficit. For example, an annual trade balance of −$800.1 billion constitutes a trade deficit of $800.1 billion.

Resolution will use the first annual estimate published in the release covering December of 2032. Subsequent annual revisions will not be considered.
markets.title: Will the U.S. goods and services deficit for 2032 be above $500 billion?

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the economic data is released.
markets.rules_primary: If the compound annual growth rate in U.S. nonfarm business labor productivity between the annual observations for 2026 and 2031 is above 1.5% per year, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary: The Underlying is the 2026 and 2031 annual observations (Q05) from BLS series PRS85006093. Annual growth is calculated as 100 × [(2031 index / 2026 index)^(1/5) − 1], using both values as available when BLS first publishes the 2031 annual observation, on the same index base. Use full published precision without rounding the calculation; the result must be strictly above the strike. Subsequent routine revisions are excluded. Growth need not exceed the strike every year, and multiple contracts may resolve Yes. Material-error corrections and unavailable data follow the contract rules.

markets.rules_primary: If the U.S. goods and services deficit for calendar year 2031 is strictly above $500 billion dollars, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The Underlying is the nominal goods and services balance on a balance-of-payments basis. It will not use the goods-only deficit, the advance goods report, the December monthly deficit, or inflation-adjusted trade data.

Because the agencies generally report the balance as a negative number, the market will use the absolute size of the deficit. For example, an annual trade balance of −$800.1 billion constitutes a trade deficit of $800.1 billion.

Resolution will use the first annual estimate published in the release covering December of 2031. Subsequent annual revisions will not be considered.

markets.rules_primary: If the New Mexico Court of Appeals, the New Mexico Supreme Court or the U.S. Supreme Court reduces, vacates or reverses, in whole or in part, the roughly $25 billion civil penalty imposed on Meta in the district court's October 21, 2026 order, including as later amended or reentered by the district court in State of New Mexico v. Facebook, Inc., No. D-101-CV-202100132 (N.M. First Jud. Dist. Ct.), or any appeal thereof before Jan 1, 2032, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
This market resolves on a written ruling of the New Mexico Court of Appeals, the New Mexico Supreme Court or the U.S. Supreme Court. The penalty under review is the civil penalty in force when that court rules, whether the roughly $25 billion ordered on Oct 21, 2026 or an amount the district court later changes.

A ruling that vacates or reverses the penalty, or any part of it, resolves the market to Yes, including a remand in which the district court may impose the penalty again. A ruling that reduces the penalty by any amount resolves the market to Yes.

The ruling must:
Be issued by the New Mexico Court of Appeals, the New Mexico Supreme Court or the U.S. Supreme Court in State of New Mexico v. Facebook, Inc., No. D-101-CV-202100132 (N.M. First Jud. Dist. Ct.), or any appeal thereof
Address the matter described by the specified judgment
Be issued through a written order, opinion, judgment, or decision

The following do NOT satisfy the Payout Criterion:
Affirmance of the penalty in full
A ruling that vacates or reverses the penalty only on grounds raised by the State, or only to reinstate or increase it
A vacatur, reversal or dismissal entered because the parties settled or the appeal became moot, without a ruling on the merits of the penalty
A change to the penalty made by the district court, including on a post-trial motion
A ruling that affects only an injunction, interest, costs, attorney fees or the amount of a bond
A stay order or an order granting, denying or dismissing a petition for review, certiorari or rehearing that does not itself reduce, vacate or reverse the penalty
Oral rulings from the bench unless reduced to a written order
Tentative rulings that are not made final
Draft opinions that leak but are not officially issued
Settlements or voluntary dismissals
Administrative or scheduling orders
Orders to show cause
Minute orders that do not address the substantive issue in the specified judgment

For clarity:
If the case is dismissed for lack of jurisdiction, that counts as a ruling only if the judgment refers to jurisdiction
Sua sponte rulings count if they match the specified judgment
Per curiam opinions and summary orders count as rulings
If multiple judges issue separate opinions, the majority/plurality opinion controls

This market is eligible for accelerated determination to No once any of the following occurs:
The penalty has become final, with no appeal or petition for review pending and the time to seek one, including a petition to the U.S. Supreme Court, expired
Every pending appeal and petition for review has been dismissed, withdrawn or denied, with no further review available
The parties have settled and no appeal or petition for review remains pending

If no qualifying ruling is issued after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2032, this market resolves to No.

markets.rules_primary: If the FDA approves midomafetamine / MDMA for PTSD for marketing before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
An approval is defined as:

For new drugs: FDA issuance of an approval letter for a New Drug Application (NDA) or Biologics License Application (BLA)
For already-marketed drugs seeking new indications: FDA approval of a supplemental NDA (sNDA) or supplemental BLA (sBLA) for the specific indication referenced
For generic drugs: FDA approval of an Abbreviated New Drug Application (ANDA)
For biosimilars: FDA approval of a 351(k) application

The following constitute approvals that trigger the Payout Criterion:

Standard approval (traditional approval based on clinical benefit)
Accelerated approval (based on surrogate endpoints)
Approval with Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy (REMS)
Approval with restricted distribution or indication limitations, except compassionate use/expanded access programs

The following do NOT constitute approvals:

Complete Response Letters (CRLs) indicating the application cannot be approved in its current form
Approvable letters that require additional actions before approval
Tentative approvals pending patent or exclusivity expiration
FDA requests for additional information or studies
Extension of Prescription Drug User Fee Amendments dates
Approval for compassionate use or expanded access programs only
Emergency Use Authorization (EUA) without full approval
Approval only for export or for use outside the United States

If the FDA issues a Complete Response Letter before Jan 1, 2027, the market will resolve to No unless the FDA subsequently approves midomafetamine / MDMA for PTSD after addressing the CRL concerns and before Jan 1, 2027.

If the FDA convenes an Advisory Committee that votes against approval but the FDA approves midomafetamine / MDMA for PTSD anyway before Jan 1, 2027, the market will resolve to Yes.

If midomafetamine / MDMA for PTSD receives accelerated approval that is later withdrawn before Jan 1, 2027, the market will resolve based on whether the initial accelerated approval occurred after Issuance (Yes), regardless of the subsequent withdrawal.

If the drug sponsor withdraws the application before FDA action and before Jan 1, 2027, the market will resolve to No immediately.

markets.rules_primary: If the United States real GDP growth in 2030 is below 0.1%, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the economic data is released.
markets.rules_primary: If the U.S. goods and services deficit for calendar year 2030 is strictly above $500 billion dollars, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The Underlying is the nominal goods and services balance on a balance-of-payments basis. It will not use the goods-only deficit, the advance goods report, the December monthly deficit, or inflation-adjusted trade data.

Because the agencies generally report the balance as a negative number, the market will use the absolute size of the deficit. For example, an annual trade balance of −$800.1 billion constitutes a trade deficit of $800.1 billion.

Resolution will use the first annual estimate published in the release covering December of 2030. Subsequent annual revisions will not be considered.

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the event occurs.
markets.rules_primary: If the Democratic Party holds more seats than any other party in the Minnesota Senate after the Minnesota legislative election held on November 5, 2030, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Rankings are determined by total seat count after the election.

Each member is counted once, for the party designation shown by the State of Minnesota. Events after the date of the general election, such as party switches, deaths, resignations, vacancies, appointments, special elections, and any decision by the Minnesota Senate to refuse to seat or to expel a member-elect, are disregarded. Independent and unaffiliated members do NOT count for any party, even if they caucus with one.

Coalitions, power-sharing agreements and the election of chamber leaders do NOT count.

In case of exact ties, markets resolve proportionally (1/number of tied parties).

This market is eligible for accelerated determination after a consensus of media organizations project that a party has won a majority of the seats in the Minnesota Senate.

markets.rules_secondary: To qualify, the announcement must explicitly state that the company has achieved, attained, reached, or developed Artificial General Intelligence (AGI), or that it has achieved, attained, reached, or developed “AGI.” Statements that describe “AGI-like,” “AGI-level,” “near-AGI,” or “toward AGI” systems without explicitly stating that the company has achieved/attained/reached/developed AGI do not qualify. The Expiration Value will be the first-published annual percent change in real GDP for 2029 from BEA’s GDP release, expected with the advance estimate of Q4 2029 GDP in early 2030. Revisions published after expiration will not be considered.

All stated bounds are inclusive. For example, “5.6% to 6.0%” includes both 5.6% and 6.0%, “6.1% or above” includes 6.1%, and “0.0% or below” includes 0.0%.

markets.rules_primary: If the U.S. goods and services deficit for calendar year 2029 is strictly above $500 billion dollars, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The Underlying is the nominal goods and services balance on a balance-of-payments basis. It will not use the goods-only deficit, the advance goods report, the December monthly deficit, or inflation-adjusted trade data.

Because the agencies generally report the balance as a negative number, the market will use the absolute size of the deficit. For example, an annual trade balance of −$800.1 billion constitutes a trade deficit of $800.1 billion.

Resolution will use the first annual estimate published in the release covering December of 2029. Subsequent annual revisions will not be considered.

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the specific individual leaves the role as defined in the payout criteria.
markets.rules_primary: If Kevin Warsh leaves as chairman of the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Kevin Warsh must have an actual departure date and vacate the role within the time period.

If the person leaves the role due to death (i.e., if the person dies while holding the role), all contracts on the person may resolve to the last fair price as determined in the sole discretion of the Exchange. Temporary leaves of absence, suspensions, or recusals do not constitute leaving, resigning from, or retiring from the role unless the individual formally and permanently ceases to hold the position. If the person vacates the role and then re-occupies the role, the contract may settle on the initial vacation of the role.

For "leave," cessation of holding the role qualifies, including resignation, retirement, removal, expulsion, expiration of term without renewal, recall, or other means by which the individual no longer occupies the role—this includes both voluntary and involuntary early departure AND the natural expiration of a term.
markets.title: Will Kevin Warsh be out as chairman of the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System before Jan 1, 2027?

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the event described in the Payout Criterion occurs.
markets.rules_primary: If Wales agrees to or announces a formal decision by the UK Government, UK Parliament, or a legally authorized Welsh authority to hold a referendum on Welsh independence after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2030, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
An agreement or announcement qualifies if it involves any of the following:

Formal signing of treaties
Parliamentary approval with binding effect
Official ratification
Formal commitment by the head of state/government with constitutional authority
Official statements by authorized ministers
Official press releases
Formal declarations during government proceedings
Official statements to international bodies

Phased implementation announcements and multi-party agreements where the country is a signatory also qualify.

The following do NOT qualify:

Preliminary discussions
Conditional agreements contingent on circumstances
Opposition party statements
Leaked documents
Think-tank recommendations
General aspirations without specific commitment
Draft legislation without approval
Regional actions (unless specified)
Retraction of previously announced commitments

Confirmation must come from the UK Government, UK Parliament, or a Welsh authority legally empowered to commit to holding the referendum. A binding legal instrument qualifies only if it commits to the poll; merely granting a power to call one does not qualify. A polling date is not required, and voting may occur after January 1, 2030. Party pledges, non-binding Senedd motions, consultations, requests for permission, preparations, and general statements of intent do not qualify. Announcements made before issuance do not qualify.

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the law is enacted
markets.rules_primary: If a state personal income tax has been enacted in Texas after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2028, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Enactment requires completion of all constitutional and legal requirements for the legislation to become binding law.

A state personal income tax means a tax imposed by the State of Texas on the income of individuals, including a tax that applies only above a specified income threshold. Taxes on businesses, such as the Texas franchise tax, and local taxes do NOT count.

Standard legislation requiring executive approval: final passage by all required legislative bodies, executive signature OR becoming law despite executive inaction OR successful veto override, and satisfaction of any required waiting periods
Constitutional amendments: passage with required supermajorities and approval by Texas voters

A constitutional amendment that only removes the Texas Constitution's ban on a personal income tax, without itself imposing the tax, does NOT count. A tax law that depends on voters approving a constitutional amendment counts only once that amendment is approved.

The following do NOT constitute enactment:

Legislative passage without completed executive action
Passage by only some required bodies
Provisional passage
Non-binding resolutions

Enactment occurs when all requirements are completed, regardless of pending judicial challenges.
markets.title: Will Texas enact a state income tax before 2028?

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the event occurs.
markets.rules_primary: If a U.S. state formally changes its official name after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Only reporting from any of the Source Agencies qualifies for the purposes of this market. Reports that merely reference prior publications (from before Issuance) do not qualify. Republishing of content originally produced by other sources (e.g., wire services) only qualifies if the content is hosted on the outlet's official platform and the outlet is clearly identified as the publishing entity.

A state formally changes its official name when the change is finally adopted under that state's own law, such as voter approval of a constitutional amendment or enactment of a law, even if it takes effect later. Adding or removing words in the official name (for example, dropping "and Providence Plantations") counts. A newly admitted state counts only if it changes its name after full admission; the name it takes at admission does not.

The following do NOT count:
A proposal, resolution or amendment that still needs a further vote or signature.
A rename made only by the President, the federal government or a private company (for example, an executive order, federal usage or map labels).
A governor's order or agency policy that changes only the name used on documents.
A nickname, motto, seal or flag.
markets.title: Will it be reported by any of the Source Agencies that a U.S. state formally changes its official name before Jan 1, 2027?

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the specific individual leaves the role as defined in the payout criteria.
markets.rules_primary: If Claudia Sheinbaum leaves (or announces she will leave) as President of Mexico before Jul 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
This market resolves based on when the departure is publicly announced or officially communicated, regardless of the effective date.

An announcement that merely acknowledges the scheduled end of Claudia Sheinbaum's term, such as a statement that she will hand over power when her term ends, does not count.

If the person leaves the role due to death (i.e., if the person dies while holding the role), all contracts on the person may resolve to the last fair price as determined in the sole discretion of the Exchange. Temporary leaves of absence, suspensions, or recusals do not constitute leaving, resigning from, or retiring from the role unless the individual formally and permanently ceases to hold the position. If the person vacates the role and then re-occupies the role, the contract may settle on the initial vacation of the role.

For "leave," cessation of holding the role qualifies, including resignation, retirement, removal, expulsion, expiration of term without renewal, recall, or other means by which the individual no longer occupies the role. This includes both voluntary and involuntary early departure AND the natural expiration of a term.
markets.title: Will Claudia Sheinbaum announce their departure as President of Mexico before Jul 1, 2027?

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the event described in the Payout Criterion occurs.
markets.rules_primary: If Northern Ireland agrees to or announces a formal decision by the UK Secretary of State for Northern Ireland to hold a border poll on Irish reunification before Jan 1, 2030, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
An agreement or announcement qualifies if it involves any of the following:

Formal signing of treaties
Parliamentary approval with binding effect
Official ratification
Formal commitment by the head of state/government with constitutional authority
Official statements by authorized ministers
Official press releases
Formal declarations during government proceedings
Official statements to international bodies

Phased implementation announcements and multi-party agreements where the country is a signatory also qualify.

The following do NOT qualify:

Preliminary discussions
Conditional agreements contingent on circumstances
Opposition party statements
Leaked documents
Think-tank recommendations
General aspirations without specific commitment
Draft legislation without approval
Regional actions (unless specified)
Retraction of previously announced commitments

A border poll is a referendum on whether Northern Ireland should cease to be part of the United Kingdom and form part of a united Ireland. A formal order directing the poll or an unequivocal official announcement recording the Secretary of State's decision to hold it qualifies. A polling date is not required, and voting may occur after January 1, 2030. Party pledges, requests, consultations, preparations, and general statements of intent do not qualify. Statements by the Northern Ireland Executive, Irish Government, or another official do not qualify unless they officially record the Secretary of State's decision.
markets.title: Will Northern Ireland confirm a reunification referendum before 2030?

events.title: Will Northern Ireland announce a reunification referendum?

The holder of the position at the time of Issuance is excluded.

For the purposes of this Contract, only a subject who holds the position in a permanent, confirmed, elected, or otherwise non-acting and non-temporary capacity, as formally designated by the body or organization at which the position is held, is treated as formally holding the position; assumption of the role solely in an acting, interim, transitional, provisional, caretaker, pro tempore, or otherwise temporary capacity does not, by itself, satisfy the Payout Criterion.
